versions.changelog:
Initial release of Project Migration Assistant.

- Generates a complete Migration Package to hand off project context, allowing another AI or new chat to seamlessly continue work without reviewing chat history.
- Collects and bundles all relevant output files (code, documents, images, etc.) produced during the session into a downloadable package.
- Proactively inspects accessible project directories and files, ensuring accurate context and avoiding reliance solely on chat memory.
- Follows a detailed 16-section handoff template, rigorously documenting decisions, progress, failures, user preferences, and open tasks.
- Avoids fabrication: honestly marks any unknown or unavailable information instead of guessing.
